title: Mini Blur and Hydrate Oil-Control Face Primer with Hyaluronic Acid
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Long-wearing✓ Best for Oily Skin✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Natural Finish

What it is: A mini primer that blurs, absorbs oil, and primes the skin, leaving a cloud like finish without mattifying.


Finish: Natural


Formulation: Cream


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Shea Butter: Boosts moisture and nourishes skin.

- Sodium Hyaluronate: Hydrates the skin and leaves it looking plumper.

- Polymethylsilesquiloxane: Increases long wear of makeup while reducing the appearance of pores.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Squeeze: Gently squeeze the tube so a generous amount of product comes out onto the applicator.
-Apply: Glide the applicator down the T-zone and outwards towards the edge of the face.
-Smooth: Use fingertips to smooth product into the skin.
Ingredients+

-Shea Butter: Boosts moisture and nourishes skin.

-Sodium Hyaluronate: Hydrates the skin and leaves it looking plumper.

-Polymethylsilesquiloxane: Increases long wear of makeup while reducing the appearance of pores.


Aqua/Water/Eau, Isododecane, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Dimethicone, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, Polyglyceryl-4 Diisostearate/Polyhydroxystearate/Sebacate, Neopentyl Glycol Diethylhexanoate, Glycerin, Diisostearoyl Polyglyceryl-3 Dimer Dilinoleate, C20-24 Alkyl Dimethicone, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Magnesium Sulfate, Benzyl Alcohol, Polysilicone-11, Phenoxyethanol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Sodium Phytate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Dehydroacetic Acid, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Tin Oxide [+/- May Contain/ Peut Contenir: Bismuth Oxychloride (CI 77163), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Titanium Dioxide (CI77891)].
